files.name: motion-prompt-095.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Animated gradient" (グラデーションアニメーション), one of the names in "Landing page & web effects".
Motion Prompt #095

What it is: Background colours keep drifting and blending
What the sample shows: Behind the headline, soft patches of orange, light orange, blue and light blue drift in circles and keep blending differently.
Spec:
- Base colour #FFF1EB, with four radial gradients on top (centre colour → transparent at the edge, each at 0.85 opacity).
- Orange (radius 230), light orange #FFB08F (210), blue (240), light blue #9DB6FB (200).
- Each centre travels an ellipse once per 4.8 s (x radii 70, 60, 80, 50; y radii 30, 40, 30, 35; start angles 0, 2.1, 4.2, 1.0 rad).
- A white headline (34 px) and a button sit on top; only the gradient moves.
When to use it: Use it to add movement and colour behind a hero or heading without using a photo.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/095.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/lp.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
